title: Bumper: Badger's Red Flag
mood: deadpan: motif head, a rest, Badger's two notes
description: Segment bumper for Badger's Red Flag, built from Zoo's motif (3.2 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: Deadpan: the motif head (D D A) on pizzicato and piano, a beat and a half of nothing, then Badger's Eb-D. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): his two notes are on the finger-plucked bass, pizzicato celli and basses, an octave-up celli double and his own cross-stick: he sits 1.7 dB over the motif head on full range and level with it on the phone model (1.1 and 2.6 dB under before). The rest's comic timing needs an ear. There is room after 2.6 s for the owner's real dog sound. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): Limiter 2.99 dB max, over 1 dB 5.9 % of the time (critic: 5.97 dB, 13.1 %; acceptance 3); Badger -0.1 dB against the motif (phone model -1.9 dB). Mud 2.26 dB (critic: 2.68; 4.7 before this bus EQ). On the button: piano D2 +0.1 c, bass +0.1 c median (n 2, 0 beyond 10 c), celli pizzicato -1.0 c median (n 5, 0 beyond 10 c), basses pizzicato -4.0 c median (n 2, 0 beyond 10 c) (critic: a 32 c spread). -1.3 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten).
